beta_notice: RunPod API v2 is beta; schema drift is treated as a first-class failure mode. The adapter refuses to operate when the live schema identity diverges from this pinned snapshot on safety-relevant surfaces (see schema_check.py).
notes: No interruptible/spot field exists anywhere in the v2 schema: v2 Pods are on-demand-only. INTERRUPTIBLE acquisition therefore uses the separately pinned GraphQL surface (GRAPHQL_SPOT_CONTRACT.json + graphql_spot.py); the adapter still asserts the absence of an interruptible field in the REST schema so drift that introduces one fails closed pending a semantics re-audit.
pinned_surfaces: GET /v2/pods, POST /v2/pods (CreatePodRequest: allOf ContainerConfig + {name*, image*, cloud, gpu{id*,count}, dataCenterIds, mounts})
GET /v2/billing, GET /v2/billing/pods (podId, startTime, endTime, bucketSize, lastN)
GpuType {id*, name*, memory*, secure*, community*, price{secure*,community*}, maxCount{secure*,community*}, availability?, dataCenters?}
repin_note: Re-pinned 2026-08-17 for the B300 migration: live v2 added cluster/ssh-key/template surfaces and renamed /v2/billing/networkvolumes to /v2/billing/network-volumes; every safety-relevant pinned surface is unchanged (no enum drift).
retrieval_method: authenticated read-only HTTPS GET (no mutating request)
